retrievalProfile.description: A centered, low-angle portrait of a female subject with voluminous dark hair, seated on a tufted sofa, featuring a large-scale thin sans-serif title overlaying the mid-section.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical studio portrait featuring a woman with dark, curly hair seated on a beige tufted sofa. She wears a horizontal-striped gold and black mini-dress and black patent leather boots. The lighting is soft but directional, creating depth in the upholstery and highlighting the texture of the hair. A large, white, ultra-lightweight sans-serif name spans the center of the frame, partially transparent or thin enough to reveal the subject behind it.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's dark hair contrasts against the light, textured tufted sofa back.
Horizontal stripes of the dress echo the horizontal orientation of the central text.
The low-angle perspective gives the subject a dominant, statuesque presence.
The white typography cuts across the high-contrast black and gold pattern of the dress.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and fills approximately 80% of the vertical frame, shot from a slightly low angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes serve as the primary focal point, framed by dark hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down the hair to the large central text, then follow the lines of the legs and boots outward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited negative space; the tufted sofa fills the entire background, creating a dense, textured environment.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Beige and cream (background upholstery and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold (dress stripes and warm highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, warm palette with high value contrast between the black elements and the light background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for maximum impact through scale rather than variety.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric purity and circular counters.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and sharp points.
Modern geometric feel with appropriate x-height.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with voluminous dark curly hair, wearing a gold and black horizontally striped mini-dress and black patent leather boots, seated on a beige tufted velvet sofa. Use warm studio lighting with a slight low-angle perspective.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of text in the center of the image using an ultra-thin geometric sans-serif font in white. The text should span nearly the entire width of the frame, positioned over the subject's midsection.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-thin and white?
Is the background a tufted sofa?
Is the subject centered with voluminous hair?
Does the dress have horizontal gold and black stripes?

adjustableVariables: Sofa color (e.g., charcoal or deep red)
mustRedesign: Avoid specific facial likeness of the original artist
Do not use exact brand logos
Ensure the text is a generic name or placeholder
postGenerationChecks: Confirm the text is legible despite its thinness.
Ensure the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Check that the gold stripes have a metallic or shimmering quality.
Verify the symmetry of the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Studio Portrait + Tufted Background + Striped Apparel + Ultra-Thin Geometric Overlay
